question: From the top of a 45 m high building, the angle of depression of a car on the ground is 30°. How far is the car from the base of the building? (Take sqrt{3} = 1.732 and round off the answer to two decimal places.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In a 30°-60°-90° right-angled triangle, the ratio of the opposite sides is 1 : √3 : 2.

The side opposite to 30° represents the height of the building = 45 m.

The side opposite to 60° represents the horizontal distance of the car from the base.

Distance = 45 × √3

Distance = 45 × 1.732 = 77.94 m

**∴ The correct answer is 77.94 m.**
